cases.scope: Processor scan-queue lock initialization and owned cleanup, with one finite remote queue user. POSIX mutex initialization may fail; ticket initialization and void-mutex normal return have no modeled failure result. Legacy controls characterize ignored POSIX failure and missing mutex-backed destruction; no OS-resource leak is attributed to the default ticket backend. Other controls reject blind failure cleanup and destruction before a remote user completes. Positive is an unimplemented checked initialization plus admission-closing/quiescence contract. Assumes no new queue users after closing and eventual completion of the admitted user under weak fairness. Excludes a complete GC protocol, C memory ordering, actual stop/join correspondence, activity-log rollback, queue content, processor storage lifetime and native acceptance.
